questions.q: Aquaman first appeared in 1941 in which DC anthology comic?
questions.why: More Fun Comics #73, dated November 1941, was Aquaman's first outing; he transferred to Adventure Comics in 1946.

questions.q: Which writer and artist pair created Aquaman?
questions.why: Editor-writer Mort Weisinger and artist Paul Norris came up with the sea-dwelling hero for More Fun Comics.

questions.q: Who played Arthur Curry in the 2018 film Aquaman?
questions.why: Jason Momoa plays Aquaman in the DC Extended Universe films, including the 2018 solo movie.

questions.q: In Aquaman's Silver Age comic origin, what is his human father Tom Curry's job?
questions.why: Arthur Curry's father is Tom Curry, a lighthouse keeper, and his mother Atlanna is an Atlantean outcast who breathes underwater.

questions.q: In which year (cover date) did Aquaman marry Mera in Aquaman #18?
questions.why: Aquaman #18 (December 1964) stages Arthur's wedding to Mera, queen of a dimension made of water.

questions.q: Which villain is generally called Aquaman's archenemy in the comics?
questions.why: Black Manta, who debuted in the 1960s Aquaman series, is described as the hero's archenemy.

questions.q: In the Silver Age comics, what is the birth name of Aquaman's half-brother, who becomes the villain Ocean Master?
questions.why: Orm Curry, Tom Curry's son from a later marriage, grows to resent Arthur and returns as the Ocean Master.

questions.q: After Aquaman lost his hand in the comics, what did he first replace it with?
questions.why: He began with a simple harpoon point; a cyber-hook that retracts and further prosthetics followed.

questions.q: In what year did Aquaman first appear in animation?
questions.why: The 1967 Superman/Aquaman Hour of Adventure marked his animated debut, and Super Friends followed in the 1970s.

questions.q: In which film did the star of 2018's Aquaman first play Arthur Curry on the big screen?
questions.why: Momoa's Arthur Curry cameoed in Batman v Superman in 2016, before Justice League (2017) and his own 2018 film.
